title: decision-points/1: each moment at which the Maintainer records continue or stop (design section 9.2), with what he was shown beforehand. A data file: its path is its identity and the commit its Release. A session fills in `shown`; he writes `decided`, `day` and `by` himself, and until he has, all three are null. That only he decides, on or after the day he was shown the counts, that a point is recorded once, and that a share is no greater than its whole, are tools/check_release.py's to hold. Slice 3 adds the second point, the first Consumer repo served, with its own measures.

point.description: Which decision point: `first_release_on_next`, the first Release on next that serves the Factory's repo

release.description: The Release the point is of

shown.description: What the Maintainer is shown before he decides: the pull requests merged into main before the point's event, against the design's starting figure

read_on.description: The day the counts were read

before.description: The event's merge: a pull request merged before it is counted

starting_figure.description: The figure the count is read against; passing it stops nothing

merged.description: The pull requests merged into main before the event

the_maintainers.description: Of those, how many the Maintainer authored, and so read and merged himself

touched_protected.description: Of those, how many changed a protected path of config/hooks.json

decided.description: The Maintainer's decision, in his own hand; null until he has made it

day.description: The day he decided; null until then

by.description: The login that decided, which is the Maintainer's as config/hooks.json names him; null until then
